new_taskcards.title: Fix Splitter REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text constraint — false positive
new_taskcards.description: The Splitter per_type_constraints in pdf.yml has REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; (for TextFragment fixture creation). This is a false positive — Splitter does not inherently require TextFragment. LLM correctly generates Splitter without TextFragment, but the constraint causes post-repair validation failure. The constraint should be changed from REQUIRED to a template_hint or removed.
new_taskcards.action: In pdf.yml, move Splitter's using Aspose.Pdf.Text constraint from required[] to supporting_using_directives[] or template_hints[]
new_taskcards.impact: Splitter regeneration will pass without prior-run preservation

new_taskcards.title: Reclassify SelectField as DELEGATE (not WORKFLOW_ROOT)
new_taskcards.description: SelectField has methods Invoke/BeginInvoke/EndInvoke — it is a delegate type used as a filter predicate in FormEditorSetOptions, FormExporterToJsonOptions, FormExporterValuesToCsvOptions. It is NOT a standalone LowCode plugin.
new_taskcards.action: Update pdf.json denominator: workflow_root_types 23→22, non_runnable 78→79. Add SelectField to excluded types list. Remove from allowed_types consideration.

new_taskcards.impact: If pass: 1 new example. If fail: reclassify as PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED.
